newsitem.title: PANAMA: Kansas City to sign Panama railway contract soon.
newsitem.headline: Kansas City to sign Panama railway contract soon.

text.p: A Panamanian unit of Kansas City Southern Industries Inc will finalize a contract to operate Panama's only railroad by April, a top government official said.
"We should finalize the contract within three months," National Port Authority deputy general director Ruben Reyna said.

The company won the exclusive concession to operate Panama Canal Railway last year and will invest "at least $60 million" in the first phase of construction which includes ripping up the old tracks to put down new ones, he said.
The railroad, which was built in the mid-1800s, will primarily transport freight between the Pacific and Atlantic coasts with plans to transport passengers at a later date.
